scope: Fresh native N versus existing bounded starting-heading hold H on the same three I73 S-path starts. Gates fixed before physics; no tuning or automatic adoption.

clock.moving_interval: Half-open [3,35); all physical-state windows otherwise include actual terminal state.
clock.command_interval: Exclude final emitted but unheld command; include actual prior input for command-step metrics.

heading_benefit.definition: Each H phase must reduce wrapped heading-error RMS over [3,45] and trapezoid integral of absolute physical world-z angular velocity over [29,45] by at least20percent versus fresh same-phase N. Heading target is the exact actual initial yaw latched by the original controller, fixed for both arms. Euler heading travel is separately descriptive/nonregression, not the primary physical rotation integral.

helper_activity.definition: Count actual held intervals with norm of recorded native heading_command[:3] at least threshold. Record original helper eligibility and lever/load masks separately.
helper_activity.limitation: This is helper activity before fade/clipping, not a full applied-command counterfactual. Actual clipping and fade are reported separately.

settling.scope: Descriptive. Report final2s and first sustained2s for the original four simultaneous criteria, and separately those four plus heading error<=10degrees. Settling is not the sole primary heading-hold gate.

hard_contracts: All six runs complete registered45s with finite actual q/v and held command histories, no physical failure, applied caps respected and applied=clip(requested).
Same-phase N/H initial physical q/v, prior input and latched heading target match exactly. No observer/goal/phase reset after launch.
All raw world XY/V/A clocks match exactly and match the frozen full route. Fixed world goal and full path used even after an early stop.
Original observer count, native load/normal/gain/support/raw-reference/preparation algorithms verified. Actual values may diverge after different physical trajectories.
Expected helper formula matches recorded native heading_command; all6 use frozen flat gain bytes and actual bounds.
Fresh N precision arrays match the corresponding I73 N common numerical fields byte-exactly; classify failed replay as setup/reproduction issue, retain it without tuning.
diagnostic_only: Full fixed-path geometric error, hold position/speed/lean, first sustained entry and later exits.
Heading error is wrapped; report unwrapped actual heading and Euler heading travel separately to reveal extra turns.
Physical world-z angular speed is R(q)*omega_body z component; it is not Euler yaw derivative.
Helper eligibility: original inferred free-shell masks, vertical/horizontal levers, torque limit, requested yaw torque, actual helper torque; no solved contacts enter control.
Current raw attitude targets can differ between N/H after state trajectories diverge; their generating algorithm is unchanged.
status_precedence: INVALID_SETUP for source/schema/seal/reference/initial/invariant/frozen-gain/baseline-replay violations; retain physical completion separately.
FAIL_HEADING_SCREEN if any H/N physical condition, any per-phase heading-benefit check or nonregression check fails.
INCONCLUSIVE if all physical/benefit/nonregression conditions pass but any H phase has less than0.10s helper activity.
PASS_HEADING_SCREEN only if all three H phases pass physical conditions, both heading benefits, all nonregression margins and activity. No automatic default adoption.
